text:
Type: natural fiber flatwoven rug
Use: adding natural texture to a seating area; living room, bedroom, dining room
Style: coastal, Japandi, rustic
Materials: tightly woven sisal-look plant fiber, bound fabric edge
Colors: warm natural tan, light beige border
Shape: rectangle with fine herringbone-like weave, narrow bound border, thin and firm, medium size, light visual weight
Feel: earthy, warm, natural, calm
Goes with: light or warm wood, rattan, cream walls, linen textiles; coastal, Japandi or Scandinavian living rooms

product.name: OSTED
product.description: The rug is hard-wearing and durable because its made of sisal, a natural fibre taken from the agave plant.
